info.title: SwiftTranslate
info.description: SwiftTranslate translates text between 107 languages with the same endpoint surface and response envelope as Google's Translate API v2 (data.translations, data.detections, data.languages), so existing code migrates by changing the host and key. It is built against the failure translation API users complain about most: an API that stops answering. Every failure returns an explicit JSON error object that names the problem; translations are cached for 24 hours and, if the engine hiccups, the last good answer is served flagged stale instead of an error; the engine call retries once before any error is returned. The engine is labeled honestly on every response (Gemini 3.6 Flash). Limits are documented: 5,000 characters per request, and every rejection states the limit and the length received. The incumbent's $9 Pro tier is free here.
